720: ★The prototype orbal gun was lost while fleeing monsters on Aina Highway, south of Ruan.

Contact Jimmy if you can help investigate. I will be waiting at the chapel.

A troublesome traveler at Air-Letten is causing serious problems. Someone who can settle the dispute peacefully is urgently needed.
